body_md:
## Fresh Developments (last 24–72h)

**SIGNAL 1 — DRAM/HBM Pricing:** TrendForce (Jun 2): Q2 conventional DRAM +58–63% QoQ (Q1 was +90–95%). 2026 HBM fully sold out; 2027 HBM4 contract negotiations underway with prices expected to rise "by multiples." Rubin Ultra pushes per-GPU HBM to 384 GB. Baseline "correction after 2026" not materializing — 2027 ASPs tracking more bullish. **BULL.**

**SIGNAL 2 — HBM4 Ramp:** SK Hynix pushed HBM4 mass production to Q3 (from Q2) — HBM3E demand too hot. Also trimming Rubin-bound HBM4 shipments ~20–30% due to Rubin platform delays. Samsung on track for ~50% HBM capacity surge. **MIXED.**

**SIGNAL 3 — Hyperscaler Capex:** No fresh 24–72h print. Combined 2026 capex: Amazon $200B, Google $175–185B, Microsoft $110–120B, Meta $115–135B (~$600–725B total). No guide-down signal. **BULL.**

**SIGNAL 4 — AMD/Custom ASIC:** MI400/Helios confirmed on track H2-2026. OpenAI committed 2 GW Trainium; Anthropic up to 5 GW Trainium (both ramping 2027). **BULL.**

**SIGNAL 5 — Optical:** No fresh 24–72h news. Lumentum CEO called 2026 "breakout year." COHR holds ~25% transceiver share. **NEUTRAL.**

**SIGNAL 6 — Solar:** Section 232 decision expected ≤July (still pending as of Jun 22). UBS raised FSLR to $330 (Jun 11, +$40); Mizuho to $300 (Jun 15, +$57); FSLR +9% on upgrades. ARRY upgraded OW by Piper Sandler ($28 target, +53% upside). **BULL (event-driven).**

**MRVL joins S&P 500 today (Jun 22):** +7.27% on Jun 21 from mechanical index inflows + record FQ1 revenue. Simultaneously, TrendForce confirms HBM4 2027 ASPs are tracking "by multiples" vs 2026 — directly refuting the baseline "correction after 2026" thesis. **Next must-watch: MU earnings Jun 24 (after close)** for HBM demand confirmation.
